text:
ashley_veridian: Hey @support, our tenant (veridian) lost access to Billing and several model endpoints right after the maintenance window. Can someone check RBAC? We can't view models or launch in console.

support_lead: Sorry about that — we're looking. Can you confirm an approximate time this started?

ashley_veridian: ~2025-06-15T14:30Z — right after KMS rotation finished. Console shows 403 on /models and billing pages.

samir_eng_oncall: Pinging eng-oncall and security. Initial suspicion: role backfill/rollback removed a binding. @julia_security any quick thoughts?

julia_security: If KMS rotation ran during the role migration it could have triggered a graceful rollback that accidentally removed tenant-scoped role bindings. Checking audit logs now.

devops-bot: Audit log entry found: action=roles.backfill.rollback actor=infra-deploy service=rbac-migration request_id=8e7f9a2b ts=2025-06-15T14:29:45Z

julia_security: Found related IAM change events:
```
principal=infra-deploy
change=remove_binding
target=role:model.viewer
scope=tenant:veridian
request_id=8e7f9a2b
```

samir_eng_oncall: Repro: tried curl to model endpoint with ashley token -> 403. Also saw KMS decrypt errors in same timeframe for service-sa used by role-syncer.

support_lead: Ashley, we're going to add you a temporary admin role while we fix. Do you want console + billing + models?

ashley_veridian: Console + billing + models would be great, yes. Thanks.

julia_security: Plan: 1) Rebind model.viewer to tenant admins for veridian 2) Re-run role backfill in safe mode 3) Rotate service-sa key mapping to re-enable role-syncer KMS decrypt 4) Audit and postmortem.

samir_eng_oncall: I'm going to run the rebind now with a one-off patch. Will post command and ETA. ETA ~6m.

samir_eng_oncall: Running:
```
rbacctl bind --tenant veridian --role model.viewer --principal \"group:veridian-admins@example.com\" --source manual --reason \"emergency restore\"
```

devops-bot: Command executed: status=OK time=14:36:12Z request_id=8e802b3c

samir_eng_oncall: Re-ran role-syncer in dry-run then apply, verifying KMS access:
```
kubectl exec -n infra role-syncer -- /app/role-sync --tenant veridian --apply
```

auditor-bot: Audit record: action=add_binding target=role:model.viewer scope=tenant:veridian actor=samir_eng_oncall request_id=8e804c9f

support_lead: Ashley, can you try accessing the billing and model pages now?

ashley_veridian: Billing access restored! Models list loads too. Thanks, I can re-run a model test and it's fine.

julia_security: KMS issue still needs follow-up: role-syncer couldn't decrypt one old key version so it skipped some automated backfills. We'll rotate the service-sa secret and add retry logic. Filing vuln/ops ticket.

samir_eng_oncall: Created ticket SEC-2025-187: role-syncer KMS retry + safe rollback guard. Assigning to eng-infra and security.

support_lead: Marking incident resolved for customer-facing access. We'll keep you updated on the remediation ticket. Sorry again for the disruption. :pray:

ashley_veridian: Appreciate the quick help, folks. Please ping when the root cause ticket lands.

julia_security: Will follow up with timeline in SEC-2025-187. Also will attach related audit logs and the postmortem draft.
